Željka Cvijanović ( née Grabovac ; Serbian Cyrillic : Жељка Цвијановић , née Грабовац , pronounced [ʒêːʎka tsʋijǎːnoʋitɕ] ; born 4 March 1967) [ 1 ] is a Bosnian Serb politician serving as the 8th and current Serb member of the Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina since 2022. She previously served as the 9th president of Republika Srpska from 2018 to 2022.
